agent_protocol.subagent_brief: Each task object describes one self-contained unit of work. Open the plan_file at the heading named in 'plan_section_heading' and follow every step in that section literally — file contents, exact commands, and commit message are all spelled out there. Use the file contents shown in the plan verbatim. Do not deviate unless you hit a typing or runtime error that must be fixed; if you do, document the deviation in your completion report.
agent_protocol.tdd_pattern: Tasks that include test files follow strict TDD: (1) write the failing test, (2) run the test to verify it fails with the expected message, (3) write the minimal implementation, (4) run the test to verify it passes, (5) commit. Do not write the implementation before seeing the test fail.
agent_protocol.completion_criteria: A task is complete only when every entry in 'verification_commands' exits 0 with the expected output AND the commit described in 'commit' has been created. Report the actual test counts and command outputs in your completion message.
do_not: Do not skip the 'verify it fails' step — it confirms the test is exercising new code, not passing accidentally.
Do not amend or rewrite earlier commits.
Do not run --no-verify or skip hooks.
Do not add features beyond what the task requires.
Do not introduce real network calls in tests. Always pass a mock fetchImpl to createAdoClient.
